info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Accounts Receivable Management API
info.description: The Accounts Receivable Management API facilitates updates to accounts receivable records, enhancing the efficiency of financial operations. This endpoint allows users to modify account details and transaction statuses based on the provided account identifier. Typical consumers include finance teams, accounting software, and business analysts aiming to maintain accurate financial data. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their invoicing processes and improve cash flow management.

patch.description: This operation updates the details of a specific accounts receivable entry identified by its ID. Ensure all necessary fields are provided in the request body for a successful update.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the accounts receivable for a specific account. This payload should include the necessary fields to modify the account's receivable data.
